summary: Verified new Google link/unlink + set-password endpoints and Settings UI. All 7 backend pytest cases pass; all frontend data-testids and flows verified end-to-end for both a fresh email/password user and a simulated Google-only user (set-password then unlink transitions).

minor.issue: FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') deprecated warnings - migrate to lifespan handlers

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage.jsx: unlink flow uses window.confirm() — consider a styled AlertDialog for design consistency.
server.py is 940 lines; consider splitting auth/datasets/ml/chat into modules once feature velocity slows.
/api/auth/link-google should also short-circuit if user already has 'google' in providers (idempotent 200) for a smoother UX; currently it still re-hits Emergent OAuth which is fine but wasteful.

unlink-google deletes ALL user_sessions for the user (line 450). That signs the user out of all devices whether or not they were Google sessions. Consider marking google sessions with a flag and only deleting those; otherwise document behaviour.
test_credentials: Fresh users signed up per test run; Google-only user simulated via direct mongo insert + minted JWT.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed with TEST_ are cleaned up after runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 covered NEW endpoints only (link-google, unlink-google, set-password, /me providers+has_password) and the SettingsPage UI. Prior iterations covered core auth (iter 1, 2). Backend tests are idempotent and self-cleaning.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All acceptance criteria from the review request met: providers=['email']+has_password:true for fresh signup, set-password 400 when already set, unlink-google idempotent for email-only users with password, link-google 400 without X-Session-ID and 401 with bogus SID, google-only user can set password (providers becomes ['google','email']) then unlink (providers becomes ['email']), Google-only user without password gets 400 'Set a password first...' guard, Settings UI shows correct rows/badges/buttons and Set-password dialog persists changes.
